name: yt-mem-ai
description: Ingest, transcribe, embed, search, and summarize/highlight YouTube videos — local-first, via the yt-ai-mcp server.
long_description: Exposes the yt-mem-ai engine as MCP tools (fetch, show, search, discover, fetch_pending, channel_list, compile, supercut, frame, recommend, ...) plus scenario prompts (summarize / highlights / Q&A / presentation / digest / review / group). Runs the published package via uvx — no source checkout.
